Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Riveo's PRO pricing sheet - a looping montage of edit clips plays behind the purchase card, crossfading between footage (portrait, purple bokeh, golden hour) while the price, trial toggle, and Start Free Trial button stay still.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Full-screen sheet: RIVEO PRO pill top, a row of stars, "Then Rs 1,900 per Year" price block, a "Try Plan for 7 Days" toggle, a blue "Start Free Trial" button, an "App Design Award" laurel badge right, X top-left. Behind everything: softly graded video clips.

## Motion spec
Pattern: ambient footage crossfade under static commerce.
- The background crossfades between clips every ~2s (700ms crossfade); each clip drifts slowly (scale 1.05 -> 1.1 over its run) so the montage breathes.
- The foreground dims the footage with a steady dark scrim (~55%) - scrim intensity never animates, so text contrast is constant through every clip change.
- Sheet entrance: rises from the bottom (spring ~300/24) with the price block fading in last (200ms delay).
- The toggle flips with a standard thumb spring; the price strikethrough/amount updates with a 200ms crossfade.

## Calibration
- All motion belongs to the background montage; commerce UI is a rock.
- Clips are real app output (effects, grades) - the footage IS the pitch.

## Reduced motion
Static background frame; no clip rotation.

## Don't miss
- The footage is portrait and full-bleed, edge to edge behind the button.
- The laurel badge sits beside the price, quietly - proof without a modal.
